s: Rin swears to defeat Satan, but doing that means entering the mysterious True Cross Academy and becoming an exorcist himself. Manga creator and illustrator Kazue Kato was born in Tokyo on July 20. From 2005 to 2006 her series Robo to Usakichi, a sci-fi adventure featuring a rabbit (again!) was published in the monthly magazine Shonen Sirius (Kodansha). Her wildely popular series Blue Exorcist began in Jump Square in April of 2009.
